name: pmcro-aspire
description: Wraps the .NET Aspire CLI's local backchannel as a PMCR-O evidence source: Maker and Checker query live Aspire resource state, console/structured logs, and traces via 'aspire describe'/'aspire logs'/'aspire otel' instead of relying on self-reported status. Also owns the safe 'aspire start/wait/stop' lifecycle commands.
